sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s from accredited university before entry; UChicago math degree compatible. Expected preparation
roughly U-M math major: calculus, differential equations, algebra/linear algebra, geometry/topology, advanced
calculus, three further math courses and two related-field courses. Historical successful GPA around 3.3 is
descriptive, not a formal cutoff. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD (distinct AIM program), collect institutional transcripts and English-medium evidence,
CV and two statements; register referees before final submission. Optional Math GRE must be merged as PDF
with transcript or personal statement. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SOP should name interested faculty; no prior commitment listed. Current directory preferred over old
number-theory group roster. Wei Ho is on leave at IAS/Princeton through current period; ascertain 2027
return/advising. Bhatt/Kaletha old Michigan mentions do not establish current normal availability; Lue Pan now
Columbia despite old seminar contact text. [s1] [s10] [s11]

Access official-transcript status. Additional PDFs/fall grades may be emailed with name/UMID. [s1] [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
October 2026 HR update: 50% GSA appointment pays USD 29,192 over two four-month semesters (USD
3,649/month by division). Math summer policy pays prevailing 50% GSI rate; applying unchanged rate for 12
months gives USD 43,788, a DERIVED planning benchmark, not published 2027-28 offer. Negotiations ongoing;
salary last rose September 2025. Tuition, GradCare and basic dental covered; exact mandatory-fee coverage
must be checked. [s7] [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Typically five years, including five summers under updated 12-month policy. Beyond fifth summer not
guaranteed. Older admissions page calls summer funding limited; specific amended 2025 policy supersedes
this for current eligible cohorts. [s7] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
PhD support applies to admitted international students; handbook provides international hiring/I-9 procedures.
MLB funded master’s bridge restricted to US citizens/permanent residents, so not this F-1 applicant’s fallback.
External citizenship rules require separate review. [s7] [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress, training and assigned work; usual 50% GSI about16-20h/week. Summer support requires
>=300 cumulative hours of employment/service, completed by fourth summer, with specified fellowship
credits/exemptions. Summer cannot be deferred. GSI/GSRA enrollment>=6 credits; fellow>=8.
Week-before-term teacher training; 3-week English training applies to non-English undergraduate background.
[s7] [s8] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
No additional essay/application for ordinary incoming GSI support listed. Internal competitive fellowships may
require nomination/self-nomination; exact incoming scholarship prompts and limits not publicly established.
[s1] [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Copeland/Glover/Rainich/Shields departmental fellowships, Rackham awards, later dissertation funding and
advisor GSRA; external fellowships/authorized internships. Advisor grant semesters are not guaranteed. Some
competitions require nomination; offer governs overlap. [s1] [s7] [s12]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD90 non-US citizen; nonrefundable, due upon submission. UChicago student does not receive
current-Rackham USD10 rate. [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math explicitly says no international fee waivers. Rackham need-based waiver restricted to US
citizens/permanent residents (Pell or SAI<1500). Central page lists program/preparatory-program codes
separately, but these do not override Math’s international restriction without written approval. Request any
eligibility clarification before submitting/paying; no refunds. [s1] [s6]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s from accredited university before entry; UChicago math degree compatible. Expected preparation
roughly U-M math major: calculus, differential equations, algebra/linear algebra, geometry/topology, advanced
calculus, three further math courses and two related-field courses. Historical successful GPA around 3.3 is
descriptive, not a formal cutoff. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD (distinct AIM program), collect institutional transcripts and English-medium evidence,
CV and two statements; register referees before final submission. Optional Math GRE must be merged as PDF
with transcript or personal statement. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SOP should name interested faculty; no prior commitment listed. Current directory preferred over old
number-theory group roster. Wei Ho is on leave at IAS/Princeton through current period; ascertain 2027
return/advising. Bhatt/Kaletha old Michigan mentions do not establish current normal availability; Lue Pan now
Columbia despite old seminar contact text. [s1] [s10] [s11]

ApplyWeb for application/referee tracking. Uploaded transcript is received by department despite Wolverine
Access official-transcript status. Additional PDFs/fall grades may be emailed with name/UMID. [s1] [s2] [s4]

All incoming PhD applicants considered for GSI support through admission; no separate ordinary funding
deadline identified beyond December 15, 2026. Named/external awards can have independent nomination
deadlines. [s1] [s7]

Optional subject GRE PDF should be in application by December 15, 2026. [s5] [s1]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]

IELTS Indicator; current acceptance should be checked against central testing page before booking. Scores
official and no older than two years by deadline. [s1] [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Exempt if ALL undergraduate education was at an English-only institution and degree completed before U-M
classes. UChicago fits if no non-English transfer education. Self-assess in application; upload transcript
front/back and registrar English-medium letter if language not recorded. Admission review verifies exemption.
[s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Excluded from admissions process; not simply optional. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]

advantage/disadvantage or official ETS subject-score requirement found. [s1] [s2]

application record. Official sealed transcript sent to Rackham after offer when directed. Fall-term updates
accepted by email. Wolverine Access may say not received because it tracks official final copies, not
departmental uploaded copies. [s1] [s2]

Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required, up to five. UChicago/in-US applicants encouraged to obtain US-institution letters; detailed
evidence/comparisons useful. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra incoming ordinary-support letter identified; named internal fellowships may require departmental
nomination and external awards separate letters. Exact scholarship-specific reference questions not public in
reviewed sources. [s7]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb Submit Recommendation Request triggers invitation; requires
name/address/email/phone/institution/title. Register all recommenders before application submission. [s4]

Invitations can be sent before submission; letters may upload before or after it. [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb Activity Page tracks status and resends requests. [s4]

Recommender name/email editable only while Not Started; In Progress/Completed requires program-approved
alternative. FERPA choice locks after recommender logs in. Cross-year reuse and submitted-letter content
replacement not documented. Paper/email only with program approval, never to Rackham. [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required ApplyWeb upload; no public page cap. Include education, work, research/publications, teaching,
professional/volunteer/community activity, honors. Top header: document type, name, program, eight-digit
U-M ID if known; margins at least one inch. [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required, concise with NO fixed math length cap. Prompt paraphrase: mathematical interests, research,
publications, camps, teaching/tutoring and desired faculty; connect academic background/goals to Michigan.
Upload with common header and >=1-inch margins. [s1] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required, maximum 500 words, distinct from SOP. Prompt paraphrase: how opportunities/challenges and life
journey motivate graduate study at Michigan; department emphasizes individuality, overcome hardships and
Math fit. ApplyWeb upload, same header and >=1-inch margins. [s1] [s3]

concise/no-fixed-cap rule. [s1]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
October 2026 HR update: 50% GSA appointment pays USD 29,192 over two four-month semesters (USD
3,649/month by division). Math summer policy pays prevailing 50% GSI rate; applying unchanged rate for 12
months gives USD 43,788, a DERIVED planning benchmark, not published 2027-28 offer. Negotiations ongoing;
salary last rose September 2025. Tuition, GradCare and basic dental covered; exact mandatory-fee coverage
must be checked. [s7] [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Typically five years, including five summers under updated 12-month policy. Beyond fifth summer not
guaranteed. Older admissions page calls summer funding limited; specific amended 2025 policy supersedes
this for current eligible cohorts. [s7] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
PhD support applies to admitted international students; handbook provides international hiring/I-9 procedures.
MLB funded master’s bridge restricted to US citizens/permanent residents, so not this F-1 applicant’s fallback.
External citizenship rules require separate review. [s7] [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress, training and assigned work; usual 50% GSI about16-20h/week. Summer support requires
>=300 cumulative hours of employment/service, completed by fourth summer, with specified fellowship
credits/exemptions. Summer cannot be deferred. GSI/GSRA enrollment>=6 credits; fellow>=8.
Week-before-term teacher training; 3-week English training applies to non-English undergraduate background.
[s7] [s8] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
No additional essay/application for ordinary incoming GSI support listed. Internal competitive fellowships may
require nomination/self-nomination; exact incoming scholarship prompts and limits not publicly established.
[s1] [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Copeland/Glover/Rainich/Shields departmental fellowships, Rackham awards, later dissertation funding and
advisor GSRA; external fellowships/authorized internships. Advisor grant semesters are not guaranteed. Some
competitions require nomination; offer governs overlap. [s1] [s7] [s12]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD90 non-US citizen; nonrefundable, due upon submission. UChicago student does not receive
current-Rackham USD10 rate. [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math explicitly says no international fee waivers. Rackham need-based waiver restricted to US
citizens/permanent residents (Pell or SAI<1500). Central page lists program/preparatory-program codes
separately, but these do not override Math’s international restriction without written approval. Request any
eligibility clarification before submitting/paying; no refunds. [s1] [s6]
